title: Motion Graphics Demo
description: Demonstrates animated zoom, pan, parallax depth, and particle effects per scene. Use zoomByScene for Ken Burns-style push-in, panByScene for lateral movement, parallaxDepth for 2.5D, and particlesByScene for atmospheric effects.
script:
Gentle zoom in on this beautiful landscape. [Visual: mountain valley landscape] [Transition: fade]
Panning across a city skyline. [Visual: city skyline panoramic] [Transition: slide]
Deep parallax effect on layered forest. [Visual: forest depth layers trees] [Transition: fade]
Sparkle particles over a magical scene. [Visual: magical starry night sky] [Transition: fade]
